results.title: Kingsley Agyemang donates medical equipment, pays patients’ bills at Kyebi Hospital
results.description: Member of Parliament for Abuakwa South, Dr Kingsley Agyemang, has donated a range of medical equipment and consumables to the Kyebi Government Hospital as part of efforts to improve healthcare delivery in the municipality.
